nodes.label: Jubilaeum Icon (Jubilee/Anniversary)
nodes.author: Fonticons, Inc.
nodes.description: SVG icon depicting a birthday cake with candles (Font Awesome Free v7.0.1). Used in the feuerwehren TYPO3 extension to represent jubilee/anniversary celebrations for fire departments (Jubilaeen feature). The icon shows a layered cake with three lit candles on top, symbolizing milestone anniversaries of fire departments in the KFV Freising district.

nodes.label: Jubilaeen Feature (Fire Department Anniversaries)
nodes.description: TYPO3 plugin feature for managing and displaying fire department jubilee/anniversary celebrations within the feuerwehren extension. Uses the jubilaeum.svg icon for visual identification in the backend and frontend.
